title: Scene Lod Grid Handle Visibility
summary: Aligned scene link-up with board WASM: (1) proximityConnect uses drag snap target + tighter screen commit tolerance (handle px + radius in px via perspective), emits onConnect then onProximityConnect like edgeCreate+proximityConnect; removed world-radius drop fallback for link pointer-up. (2) indirectConnect on sole free compatible handle emits onConnect+onIndirectConnect; multi-handle drops enter LinkTargetNode-style state with ring highlights, rubber line, second pointer-down ray pick on ring handle or cancel on miss; window capture pointerdown. (3) Vortex meta radiusWorld for snap halos; ThreePerspectiveCamera import alias to avoid drei name clash.
